title: Dave Crompton Appointed to Board of Directors of Garrett Motion Inc.
author: Na
description: Garrett Motion announced the appointment of Dave Crompton, Executive Chair and Co-Founder of Pioneer Clean Fleet Solutions and former President and CEO of Achates Power, to its Board of Directors. Crompton brings over 40 years of leadership experience in commercial transportation, industrial, and power generation, including 28 years at Cummins Inc. The appointment is expected to support Garrett's strategy to expand beyond automotive into industrial applications.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The appointment of an experienced industry executive with deep expertise in advanced powertrain technologies and a strong track record at major companies like Cummins strengthens the board's capabilities. This signals confidence in the company's strategy to expand beyond automotive into industrial applications and supports long-term value creation.
Cummins is mentioned only as a former employer of the newly appointed board member. The mention is historical context with no direct impact on Cummins' current operations or strategy.

title: Garrett Motion adds a turbocharged twist to Carmel's AI-heavy portfolio
author: Seena Hassouna
description: Carmel Capital Management acquired 314,750 shares of Garrett Motion (GTX) for approximately $5.87 million in Q1 2026, representing a new 1.6% position in the fund. The acquisition fits within Carmel's broader industrial and automotive supply chain strategy, complementing existing holdings in auto chips, aftermarket parts, and aerospace propulsion. GTX shares have surged 129% over the past year, significantly outperforming the S&P 500.

title: Oaktree Knows Distressed Debt. Its Garrett Motion Sale Tells You Something.
author: Seena Hassouna
description: Oaktree Capital Management sold 14.8 million shares of Garrett Motion (GTX) in Q4 2025 for an estimated $235.64 million, reducing its position by nearly half. However, the firm retained $298 million worth of shares, keeping GTX as its fifth-largest holding. The partial exit suggests Oaktree has recouped significant returns from its original distressed debt investment when Garrett emerged from bankruptcy in 2020, while maintaining confidence in future upside.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock has appreciated 89.5% over the past year, outperforming S&P 500 by ~75%. Oaktree's decision to retain a $298 million position (fifth-largest holding) after taking profits signals continued confidence in the company's recovery trajectory and future growth potential, despite the partial exit.

title: GTX Shares Lower On Cautious FY26 Automotive Production Outlook
author: Lekha Gupta
description: Garrett Motion (GTX) reported Q4 earnings beating expectations with $891M in net sales and $0.42 adjusted EPS, but shares fell 7.97% due to cautious FY26 guidance. The company projects light vehicle production to decline 1-3% in 2026, offsetting strong commercial vehicle growth and progress in electric powertrain technologies.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While Q4 earnings beat consensus estimates and the company demonstrated strong cash flow and margin expansion, the stock declined 7.97% due to cautious FY26 guidance projecting a 1-3% decline in light vehicle production, which appears to have outweighed the positive earnings results and offset optimism about new electric technology wins.
